recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Fortress use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Fortress card.

items.label: Everwinter Glacier
items.description: Enable attacks and Direwolf supply from your owned Everwinter Glacier main castle when that kingdom is unlocked.
items.recommendation: On when unlocked and ready to use.

items.label: Burning Sands
items.description: Enable attacks and Direwolf supply from your owned Burning Sands main castle when that kingdom is unlocked.
items.recommendation: On when unlocked and ready to use.

items.label: Fire Peaks
items.description: Enable attacks and Direwolf supply from your owned Fire Peaks main castle when that kingdom is unlocked.
items.recommendation: On when unlocked and ready to use.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Fortress kingdom controls for the three outer kingdoms
image.caption: Enable each unlocked kingdom whose main castle should receive Direwolves and attack fortresses.

items.label: Direwolves per session
items.description: Limit Nomad-shop Direwolf purchases in batches of 100 for each shop session; 0 disables buying.
items.recommendation: 5,000 Direwolves per session at the cheapest tier.

items.label: Keep Khan tablets
items.description: Stop Direwolf purchases before your Khan-tablet balance falls below this reserve.

items.label: Use time skips for Direwolf transfers
items.description: Use eligible Time Skips only for confirmed Auto Fortress shipments while respecting saved inventory reserves.
items.recommendation: On for faster resupply when your saved Time Skip reserves allow it.

items.label: Direwolf supply route
items.description: Purchased Direwolves arrive at the Great Empire main castle and are distributed to enabled kingdoms.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Fortress Direwolf purchase and transfer settings
image.caption: Review the per-session purchase ceiling, Khan-tablet reserve and confirmed-transfer Time Skip choice.

items.label: Commander assignment
items.description: In Commanders, assign the commanders Auto Fortress may use, then save those assignments.
items.recommendation: Assign the commanders you normally want available for fortress attacks.

items.label: Fastest eligible commander
items.description: For each fortress, Auto Fortress chooses the fastest currently available assigned commander using applicable equipment, gem, set and general speed effects after caps.
items.recommendation: No Relic 2.0 item or 100% speed bonus is required.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose the travel option for fortress attacks; an explicitly saved coin or ruby tier stays selected.
items.recommendation: Travel Feather for the fastest travel.

items.label: Daily normal-attack limit
items.description: Stop Auto Fortress at your account-wide daily normal-attack count until the game resets it; 0 adds no limit.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you want an additional daily cap.

items.label: Direwolf flank wave
items.description: Each attack waits for enough Direwolves to fill both flanks in one full wave.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Fortress attack and travel settings
image.caption: Auto Fortress ranks eligible assigned commanders for each target and uses the saved travel choice.

steps.title: Set the schedule, save and enable

items.label: Calendar
items.description: Use Calendar to restrict when Auto Fortress may run, then select Save Schedule for any schedule changes.

items.label: Save fortress plan
items.description: Save the kingdom, supply and attack settings before leaving this dialog.

items.label: Auto Fortress switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Fortress on the Automation card after saving to start its normal cycles.
items.recommendation: On after reviewing and saving your intended settings.
